description: List tickets in a workspace with optional filters — panel, state, type, project, assignee, label, iteration, what changed since a moment, when they were created, when they are due, or a search — 50 to a page, in board order or by due date. A panel comes with its release, milestone and deadline markers. The reply says when more pages exist, and when markers were left out.

created_after.description: Only tickets created on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD

created_before.description: Only tickets created on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD

due_after.description: Only tickets due on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD. For "what is due this week?"

due_before.description: Only tickets due on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD

include_markers.description: Include release, milestone and deadline markers. On by default when panel is given, off otherwise

iteration_id.description: Only tickets in this iteration, by its number from list_iterations, or none for tickets in no iteration

label.description: Only tickets carrying this label, by name as list_labels shows it

panel.description: Filter by panel, which the board shows as Icebox, Backlog, Current and Done

project_id.description: Project external ID, to list a project's tickets. Add panel to see only what is left.

requester_id.description: Only tickets this person asked for, by user ID. For "what did I ask for?"

sort.description: due_date: soonest due first, undated last. recent: most recently finished first. Unset: board order.

stakeholder_id.description: Only tickets this person decides on as stakeholder, by user ID

ticket_type.description: Filter by type (feature, bug, chore, research, milestone, release, deadline)

updated_since.description: Only tickets changed after this moment, as a date or an ISO 8601 time (2026-09-22, or 2026-09-22T09:00:00Z). For "what changed since Monday?"

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID, as list_workspaces gives it. Defaults to the one workspace this connection reaches; required when it reaches several.

name: list_tickets
title: List tickets
